notes: WHAT'S NEW IN 4.2.2: TUNEHIVE REFERENCE CONFORMANCE — same-to-same UI fix only, no functionality changed. (1) WELCOME: big glossy lime 3D headphones hero image (replaces the white vibe logo here only), CTA rebuilt as the reference bottom bar — lime round button + 'Turn on your music' + headphones icon circle. (2) HOME: new greeting header (avatar + time-based Good Morning/Afternoon/Evening + 'Music Lover' + bell opening quick actions), 'Select Categories' chips All/Party/Blues/Sad/Hip Hop wired to real search, 'Popular Songs' is now a real row of 3 large square art cards from the Top 10 Chart data, 'New Collection' wide cards incl. 'Top Songs Global / Discover 86 songs' from the real mix data. (3) BOTTOM NAV: Home (lime circle) / Search / Heart (Liked Songs) / Profile — Mic and the '•••' button removed from the nav (voice search stays in the search box; all quick actions still reachable). (4) PLAYER: current track art is now the full-bleed photo background under a dark olive overlay, thin SVG arc progress with a heart at top centre + time, WHITE play/pause button in the centre of the lime ring, shuffle/repeat flanking the ring, prev/next below. (5) ONE THEME ONLY: all themes except TuneHive removed from Settings and the code; the header button now opens Settings → Appearance instead of cycling themes. (6) All blue defaults removed (player fallback, letter-art tiles, accent fallbacks). Kept from 4.2.1: Tareefan symmetric Saavn ↔ YouTube fallback, cyberxapi YouTube search (primary), vibe logo elsewhere, MP3 only, Google sign-in, audio-output indicator (Phone speaker / Bluetooth · name). NOTE for 4.1.5 users: the in-app download can stick at 0% on 4.1.5 — if it does, tap Cancel and install the APK file sent in chat, it updates the same app.
